newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE'S BATTY SUSPENDED FOR UEFA CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE'S BATTY SUSPENDED FOR UEFA CUP MATCH.

text.p: England midfielder David Batty has been ruled out of Newcastle's UEFA Cup clash with Swedish side Halmstads on Tuesday because of a suspension dating back to his days with Blackburn Rovers.
Batty squared up to his former Blackburn and England team mate Graeme Le Saux during a Champions' League tie with Spartak Moscow in Russia last November.
Angry words turned to actions as Le Saux threw a punch that caught Batty in the throat, and goalkeeper Tim Sherwood had to intervene to prevent a fight.
Batty was not cautioned for the incident, but after examining video evidence, UEFA intervened and gave both players a two-match ban.
Batty served half the ban with Blackburn before joining Newcastle last season and will therefore be eligible for the second leg of Newcastle's UEFA Cup tie in Sweden.
Le Saux, who is still at Blackburn, broke a leg last season and has not played since.
Newcastle's John Beresford also misses Tuesday's first round match after picking up two bookings when Kevin Keegan's side last played in Europe in the 1994-95 season.
